title: Zero-Up: Crossing an Impossible Draft
question: Can a planning representation pass through an infeasible intermediate ordering while ending in a feasible, exact-source schedule?
method: Four-operation enumeration, machine-load lower bound and recorded unchanged 600-operation heuristic comparisons with separate input checker.
finding: A four-operation shop has exact optimal makespan 4; on the large shop changing tentative machine orders helped relative to frozen orders but did not find an optimum.
claim_scope: Exact tiny theorem; reported finite 600-operation heuristic runs only.
limitations: The complete 600-operation source, CSVs and checker are not in the selected material.
open_questions: What additional conclusions, if any, would the original missing evidence support?
